summary.method: Core table sections verified from archived responses; nonempty cone rows retained and compared with target TIC/Gaia identifiers and separation; shared Gaia success receipt includes each target. No fresh network request needed.

simbad_operational_standard.practice: Original paper code queried primary otype, not full otypes; accepting the successful primary SB* response is consistent with that operational standard. A full type-list requirement would add a stronger gate.
